name: Airbyte
description: Monitor Airbyte data integration pipelines for connection status and workspace access compliance

config.setupInstructions:
1. Log in to Airbyte Cloud at https://cloud.airbyte.com (or your self-hosted instance).
2. Go to Settings > Applications.
3. Create a new Application; copy the Client ID and Client Secret (secret shown only once).
4. Paste them above. For self-hosted Airbyte, also enter your API Base URL.
5. Comp will exchange these for short-lived access tokens automatically.

credentialFields.label: API Base URL (optional, self-hosted only)
credentialFields.helpText: Defaults to https://api.airbyte.com for Airbyte Cloud. For self-hosted Airbyte, enter your instance URL (e.g. https://airbyte.example.com/api/public).
